description.zh:
事件名称。

>详细信息请参见[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The event name.

>For more information, call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
The source identifier of the request. Set the value to sas.
The time when the event was first detected.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取。
description.en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value.
The vertex type. You can call the [DescribeTraceInfoDetail](~~DescribeTraceInfoDetail~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh: 指定要查询的服务器uuid。通过 [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en: The UUID of the server to query. You can call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-trace-info-node --source-ip 127.0.XX.XX --lang zh --vertex-id 03da4e2350a3eb50cd25a18cexxxxxxx --type SAS_ASSET --event-name WEBSHELL --incident-time 1635978934000 --uuid 6f346617-eef9-45e6-b6d1-946xxxxxxxx --from sas --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeTraceInfoNode --region cn-hangzhou --IncidentTime 1635978934000 --Type SAS_ASSET --SourceIp '127.0.XX.XX' --Uuid '6f346617-eef9-45e6-b6d1-946xxxxxxxx' --Lang zh --VertexId 03da4e2350a3eb50cd25a18cexxxxxxx --EventName WEBSHELL --From sas
